narrative: In particular, we found a malicious file uploaded to VirusTotal, which ultimately drops a Zebrocy malware and communicates with a C2 in France. This padding is used to evade hash-matching security controls, since the dropped malware will always have a different file hash value. At the time of the discovery, the C2 infrastructure hosted in France was still live.
